sentences.en: Their stay in Germany for a year was very fruitful.
sentences.zh: 他们在德国一年的学习收获很大。

sentences.en: Their year-long stay in Germany was very fruitful.
sentences.zh: 他们在德国的一年学习很有成效。

sentences.en: The debate was very contentious and didn't result in any fruitful conclusions.
sentences.zh: 这场辩论很激烈，但没有得出任何有意义的结果。

senses.zh: 富有成效的，卓有成效的；富有成果的，多产的，丰富的
